spans.s:
m. (-मः)
Want of order or arrangement, confusion, irregularity.
E.
अ priv. and क्रम order.

m. (-मः)
1 Going over or beyond.
2

Surpassing.
3

Spreading over or upon.
4

Overloading.
5

Attaining, overcoming, obtaining.
6 Invading, attacking, falling upon.
7 Might, valour.
E.
आङ् before क्रम to go, to mount, ascend, surpass, &c. affix अच्.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Unpassed, unsurpassed.
2 Unconquered.
f. (-त्तः)
The egg-plant. (Solanum melongena.)
E.
अ neg. and क्रान्त passed.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Surpassed, surmounted.
2 Overcome, overrun.
3 Pained, distressed.
4 Accompanied, attended.
5

Overspread.
6

Obtained, possessed.
7 Agitated or overcome by, as a feeling.
E.
आक्रम to mount, surpass, &c. and part. affix क्त.

m. (-धः)
Dispassionateness, restraint of anger, one of the ten duties of an ascetic.
mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Dispassionate.
E.
अ neg. and क्रोध anger.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Inactive, dull, torpid.
2 Abstaining from religious rites.
f. (-या)
Inactivity, neglect of what ought to be done.
E.
अ neg. क्रिया act.

n. (-त्वं)
Inactivity, torpor. त्व added to the preceding. also अक्रियता.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Gentle, not cruel.
m. (-रः)
The paternal uncle and friend of KṚṢṆA.
E.
अ neg. क्रूर cruel.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Who checks or restrains.
m. (-न्दः)
1 Crying, crying out.
2

Calling.
3

Weeping, sobbing.
4

Sound.
5

Violence.
6

Furious or violent combat.
7 A friend.
8 A brother.
9 A king, a lord.
10 A usurper.
11 A king who [] prevents an ally from aiding another.
E.
आङ्, क्रन्द to cry, to sound, &c. अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Going where sounds of distress are heard.
E.
आक्रन्द and ठञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Going over or beyond.
2 Overpowering, subduing.
3 Spreading or extending over or upon.
4 Attacking, marching against, invading.
E.
आङ् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be attacked.
2 To be surpassed or overcome.
3 To be seized.
E.
आङ् before क्रम to go, अनीयर aff.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Going over or beyond.
2

Overpowering.
3

Might, valour.
E.
आङ् before क्रम to go, affix क्तिन्: see आक्रम.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Invading, assailing
2 Overrunning.
E.
आङ् before क्रम to go, ण्वुल aff.

m. (-डः)
1 A royal garden.
2 Sport, pleasure.
E.
आङ्, क्रीड to play, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Sporting, taking pleasure.
E.
आक्रीड to sport, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-डी-डिनी-डि)
Sporting, playing.
E.
आक्रीड to play, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1

Cursed.
2

Accused, calumniated.
3

Abused.
4

Vociferated.
E.
आङ् before क्रश to call, affix क्त.

m. (-शः)
1 Abuse, censuring, a curse or oath.
2 Vociferousness, calling aloud.
E.
आङ्, क्रुश to call, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Abusing, abusive.
2 Vociferous.
E.
आक्रुश to call, वुञ्^1 aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

n. (-नं)
Curse, imprecation.
E.
आङ्, क्रुश to call, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be accursed, censurable, reprovable.
E.
आङ् before क्रुश to cry, अनीयर् affix; also आक्रुश्य and आक्रोशितव्य.
